text:
ravi: Heads-up — after the embed route canary we started seeing spikes of 413s for tenant 'blueco'. Pattern looks like dims oscillation: header dims flip between 512 and 1536 causing splitter to pick different chunking paths and then reject. Need quick sync on quota/alerting + console cues.
monica: Do we even emit dims distribution anywhere? Console only has avg bytes and total requests, no dim percentiles.
elaine: Saw the same in logs. Example: header `X-Embed-Dims: 1536` but payload bytes ~2048; splitter expected larger aligned chunk -> rejected with 413. Short stack trace in logs: `splitter: unmatched slot size -> payload_too_small`.
josh: Can we add a short-term alert: if /v1/embeddings 413 rate > 5% over 5m for any tenant -> page oncall? Also create KPI for 50/90/99 dim percentiles per tenant.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary roll deploy/embeds-splitter-v2 finished at 2026-03-21T10:05:12Z on 3 hosts.
sam: Short-term mitigation idea: an advisory preflight that returns a shape suggestion header instead of hard-fail. Response 200 with `X-Embed-Shape-Hint: dims=512;bytes=4096;note=chunk-friendly` and telemetry tag `preflight=true`. SDKs can choose to honor suggestion. Console shows banner when preflight helps reduce 413s.
carol: @sam how's this different from existing preflight? We need to avoid more oscillation if clients flip shapes quickly.
sam: Preflight is advisory only — no auto-rewrite. We'll also emit a `dim_stability` metric: % of requests that change dims between consecutive requests per tenant. If stability < 80% for 1m and 413s spike, we surface a console recommendation to enforce client-side stable dims or enable server-side normalization.
monica: :thumbsup: For console work: add a dashboard card with a dims histogram (buckets: 64/128/256/512/1024/1536/2048+), overlay recent 413 rate, and a rollup showing tenants with highest dim volatility. Also surface the preflight toggle in tenant settings.
josh: I'll add the alert + playbook: when 413% > 5% for 5m: auto-enable preflight for that tenant (opt-out) and ping the owner. If after 10m 413% still > 8% rollback canary or scale down splitter experiments.
ravi: Decision: Monica + Josh own KPI + alert work. Sam to implement preflight header and telemetry tag. Elaine to design UX banner and toggle. Ops to monitor; rollback condition: >8% 413s post-mitigation.
elaine: I'll drop a quick mock in #design in ~30m and link here.
monica: Thanks — will open dashboard PR and tag y'all.
